channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Far-right commentator Milo Yiannopoulos removed from US, officials say
item.description: Yiannopoulos was removed from the U.S. after immigration authorities arrested him in Louisiana over an alleged visa overstay.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Ford says Lake Ontario ‘always’ will keep its name despite Trump order
item.description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiled a “Lake Ontario, now and always” sign after President Trump ordered the lake renamed “Lake America."

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Clearwater mayor talks hurricane recovery, historic pavilion
item.description: Mayor Bruce Rector spoke with Tampa Bay 28 anchor Andrew Kinsey about ongoing recovery efforts from Hurricanes Helene and Milton and new ownership of Crabby's Beachside Pavilion.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Clearwater Beach lifeguards on pace for record water rescues in 2026
item.description: Water rescues at Clearwater Beach have grown every year since 2024, and 2026 is on track to shatter records, according to Clearwater Fire and Rescue.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Clearwater Beach ranked second best in the US and 17th in the world for 2026
item.description: TripAdvisor named Clearwater Beach the second-best beach in the United States for 2026, ranking it 17th worldwide.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pedestrian killed in crash on Dundee Road near Winter Haven: PCSO
item.description: A 78-year-old man was killed Friday night after being struck by a car on Dundee Road between Winter Haven and Dundee, according to the Polk County Sheriff’s Office (PCSO).

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Green lights for good drivers: A new approach to traffic safety
item.description: Cities are testing “rest in red” traffic systems that slow speeding drivers and improve safety on dangerous roads.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Celebrate Birthdays' Cupcake Crawl celebrates local boy beating cancer
item.description: Runners laced up at Al Lopez Park for the fourth annual Cupcake Crawl 5K and Cup-One-K Dash. Participants were greeted with cupcakes at the finish line during the annual fundraiser on Saturday.

item.description: PLYMOUTH, Mass. (AP) — Jurors in the closely watched Lindsay Clancy trial began deliberating this week — but had not reached a verdict by the end of the day Friday.
